verses.text: Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, haton tz'ak'an wip. Haton wal tzin k'ayb'ani, syak'anpax in jelanil yik wach' swak' owal.
Haton icha in nhak'een, icha wal in cuartel, in Kolumal paxi. A' tzin k'ub'aneli. A' ayoch wenhulok. A' tz'ak'anoch heb' chonhab' t'a yalanh in mandar.
Mamin Jehová ¿tas wal jab'ok kelk'och a onh anima onh tik t'a yol a sat, yuj chi' tzonh a nakoti? ¿Tas wal kelk'ochi yuj chi' tzonh a ya'ilej?
Ha onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha wal b'aj skik' kik', haxo ko k 'inal icha wal junok enhul tz'ek'i.
Mamin, jak spuertail satcha'anh yik tzach emuli. Tzach emul t'a jolomtak witz yik sk'e stab'il lum uuj.
Julemta junok a jul-lab', haton jun k'ak' tzek' kopnajok, tza pechanb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a skal somk'olal.
Masanto t'a satcha'anh chi' tzak'emta a k'ab' tzin a kolanel t'a jun ha' mar te niwan, syalelk'ochi, haton heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Kolinel t'a heb' esalwum chi', haton heb' syik'chaanh sk'ab' syak'an sti' t'a tastak manh yelok.
Ach in Diosal, ol in b'itej jun ak' b'it t'ayach. Ol in b'itan yet' sb'ital salterio t'ayach.
Uuj wal, syal yuj heb' rey, a ach ton ix in a kol t'a k'een espada tzonh milanchamok, a in David a chekab' in tik.
Ha tiknaik, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' esalwum syak' sti' t'a tastak manh yelok syala'.
K'ib'okab' heb' kuninal icha wal tas tz'awchaj to ya ilab'il. Ha heb' ix kisil lajanokab' heb' ix icha junok yoyal templo tzeyb'il, te wach' yilji.
Ha ko pat, b'ut'jinakokab'el yuj junjun makan wael. Ha nok' ko kalnel, k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a smilal. Manhxo b'ischajb'enokab' tz'aj sb'isul nok' ko wakax.
Unewiokab' nok', mokab' tonhejok tzek' sti' nok'. Malajokab' mach tz'el yaw t'a yol scalleal ko chonhab' yuj yaelal.
Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to icha chi' yaji. Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok.
